brief: Add a new dashboard screen to the notes app. A navigation with "Notes" and "Dashboard" buttons switches between the notes list and the dashboard. The dashboard loads the stats API at GET /api/stats, which returns { total, done, overdue }, and shows the three numbers with the labels "Total", "Done", and "Overdue". Below them it lists the five most recently created notes from GET /api/notes, newest first. If the stats cannot be loaded, show an error message there but still list the recent notes. Add tests.
